{"contract_id":"d9e5e1f1efba187dfce2e80b395a1db533e89e8a97bd11c6f2f1e51d1ee9bb3e","definitions":"D1 (fixed source family). The alphabet is {0,1}. For unknown 0<u<1/4 and t in [1/4,3/4], put w=(1-u)/3 and r=ut/w. The stationary pair law in order (00,01,10,11) is pi=(u,w,w,w); next-symbol-1 probabilities are (t,1/2,1-r,1/2). Allowed pair transitions are ab->bc only. Initialize (X_1,X_2) from pi and observe X_1,...,X_N, N>=3; X_(N+1) is invisible. All allowed symbol successors are strictly positive. The family includes the first-order subcurve t=(1-u)/(1+2u) when it lies in the stated domain. Upper bounds include it; genuinely second-order lower witnesses must avoid it. Algorithms know the model structure and N,b, not u,t, exact pi, unseen transitions or source-dependent auxiliary labels.

D2 (risk and estimators). S_N=(X_(N-1),X_N) is the actual query from the same history. Natural-log risks are R_N(u,t;q)=E_(u,t) KL(p_(u,t)(.|S_N)||q(X_1^N)) and R_N,00(u,t;q)=E_(u,t)[KL(p_(u,t)(.|00)||q(X_1^N)) | S_N=00]. All private randomization is source-independent conditional on the observed history. An unrestricted comparator may use the entire observed history; the constructed predictor may deliberately use a prefix but must charge its query access. Pointwise-law, uniform-in-law, conditional, averaged, fixed-N and triangular parameter choices are distinct. No independence between query and counts is assumed. The lower-bound class can even reveal u to the predictor if a valid proof establishes that stronger comparator bound; the common attaining algorithm is never given u.

D3 (minimax and output format). Let A_N be all source-independent measurable probability predictors using X_1^N (and optionally an independent private seed). Let A_N,Q require every output to lie almost surely in Delta_Q^+={(j/Q,1-j/Q): j=1,...,Q-1}, Q=2^b, integer b>=1. Define M_N=inf_(q in A_N) sup_(u,t in D1) R_N, M_N,Q analogously over A_N,Q, and C_N(u)=inf_(q in A_N) sup_t R_N,00(u,t;q), C_N,Q(u) analogously. In the fixed-u minimax expression u may be a known class parameter for the lower-bound comparator; simultaneous achievability must use one algorithm independent of u. Theta order means two positive numerical constants independent of N,Q,u,t, not exact constants or equality of minimizers. With positive full-support histories, a grid algorithm that actually outputs a zero coordinate with positive conditional seed probability on any history has infinite expected KL; merely allowing zero in a format does not assert that it occurs. The exact cost of numerator/denominator or dyadic scalar outputs must be stated.

D4 (candidate estimator and proof entry, not new-project facts). For N>=6, m=floor(N/2), M=m-2, g=N-m. Count triples only at 3,...,m and evaluate their row selected by S_N. For row00, use clip_[1/4,3/4]((C_001+1)/(D_00+2)) as next-1 estimate. For row10, use min(3/4,(C_100+1)/(D_10+2)) as next-0 estimate; do not lower-clip this rare probability by a fixed positive constant. Rows01,11 and N=3,4,5 use 1/2. All sample discarding is real. At row00 use a finite nearest-Q-grid rule with declared ties, preserving strict positivity; at row10 use a finite positive ceil/residual converter. A possible binary converter from positive integers z0,z1 is A=Q-1, j_c=ceil(A z_c/(z0+z1)) by integer quotient/remainder, then give the nonnegative residual to coordinate1. All branches must be proved and costed. Existing 009 used this latter converter at every row; its O(1/Q) conditional bound is not the desired sharp conditional classification.

The proposed proof tools include P^3(x,01)>=1/32 and stationary reverse R^3(x,10)>=1/32, with R obtained by swapping labels01/10 in P. This is not ordinary detailed balance. Reverse data processing can compare the entire prefix law given S_N=s to its stationary law without division by pi_s. Predictable transition martingales, spaced-visit bounds and fixed-length row-stack tail events must be justified without asserting binomial counts conditional on random visits. Every candidate formula requires normal native verification.

D5 (candidate causal frontend). Physical query token is at N+1 after the observed sequence. First-layer paid singleton heads obtain local predecessor bindings, prefix endpoint E_m=(X_(m-1),X_m), and actual terminal S_N, with all QKV, masks, flags, routing and holds charged. The synthetic query never becomes an eligible sample. A routed prefix has eligible keys exactly3,...,m. Two product-match heads with fixed gamma=1, lambda1=1,lambda2=2, one uniform marginal/initial-flag head, and one lag2 partial-match head with kappa=1 provide the statistical masters. Initial and terminal path-flow corrections use the prefix boundaries, while row selection uses S_N. These are the itemwise product kernels, not the full-context A kernel. The prior source implementation gives a candidate finite coefficient/log/exp and signed count recovery, with Q_A>=256(N-2) a sufficient internal schedule; it is not admitted here by copying and is not a necessity claim. The adapter and modified row00 quantizer are additional paid operations. No exact count, pair/triple table, normalizer, length, future symbol or raw-history readout bypass is free.

D6 (resource and reliability scope). Report R=(L,W,H,D_qk,parameter bits,arithmetic/activation bits,score range), complete stored program/mask/position/parameter bits, rolling and peak working bits, copy/erase/hold/address costs, generation time and online bit operations. Explicitly distinguish hybrid finite-attention evaluation, shared sparse programs, global dense batch networks, fully flattened Boolean/ReLU circuits and streaming algorithms. A streaming counting block's small live state is not the width of a one-shot full-history batch network. Baselines may use the same full history and publicly known structure and reallocate budgets; identical-bit comparisons and negative advantage conclusions are valid. This stage proves nominal finite arithmetic; any extra perturbation guarantee requires its own declared port/model and is not required by or smuggled into the risk theorem. Finite output quantization is part of the actual predictor, not an empirical approximation to a real oracle.

D7 (provenance and stages). Prior stage1 root4f974bc0673ee0456e1ba3acbe18fd194e9f8f8fa0a29e4d2ed8c2296f52c140 is SOLVED. Prior stage2 project icml-flow-heads/root2b80c631152f22bae0797d03b25703a6dc785dcec5fe5f9c8dd4078ed8243b38/contract22e80d3d620c36cfc0bbd297101a5efabe634d7fd696b4cae200963af52af02a has Acceptance f2e2e536ecc57909e1646ed8f946b6db445646b5a0a92e9dba9ff55c3a8361c7. Both are immutable. Stage2 source C1/count-snap Facts, outputs008/009 and independent discussion reports are copied as source material only; no native Fact/evidence is inherited automatically. [Non-scientific operational metadata omitted.] Parked candidates007/014/018/019/020 are not reopened. The current v10 mother problem, T1->T2->T3 and autonomous continuation rules persist; publication novelty and neural superiority are not predetermined.

Realize the C2 common integer branches incl nearest half-up row00 and positive ceil/residual row10 with all N,Q cases. Give explicit sufficient resource functions in N,b for hybrid, shared, dense, flattened and streaming cost domains incl finite attention evaluation and generation. Prove an eight-counter sequential-input baseline returns identical bits with the same tie/residual, without asserting optimized full-network dominance. Preserve known endpoint-substitution failure and avoid precision/depth necessity claims."}
